meta.name: Dies Natalis HIFI 68 · Kasundaan Web
meta.description: Original Kasundaan identity in one pinned full-screen stage; name/NPM/chosen-password registration and anonymous Harewos.

primary.role: Primary actions, type accents, navigation and footer

secondary.role: Display accents, message labels and status emphasis

neutral.usage: Original poster cream with teal-tinted ink

color.contrast_strategy: Dark teal, ink and burgundy on light cream, sage or terracotta; cream on primary actions and footer

font_families.heading: Libre Baskerville
font_families.mono: system monospace for developer documentation only

typography.font_style_notes: Original native Canva wordmark rendered as an image with accessible H1; local Libre Baskerville headings and Montserrat controls.

spacing.section_rhythm: Framed cultural hero, chronological events, logo exploration, anonymous messages, raffle, merchandise and practical information

layout.alignment_tendency: Asymmetric original wayang/logo collage paired with left-aligned editorial typography; compact mobile stack

shape.border_usage: Restrained neutral lines on controls and navigation
shape.divider_style: Subtle tonal separators; wide section gaps

elevation.depth_cues: tonal shading embedded in original logo

iconography.style: Actual Canva ornaments with simple stroke utility icons

motion.animation_density: Persistent source cutouts move through one shared stage; Arjuna/Semar image children sway subtly in CSS, with no perpetual JavaScript render loop.
motion.scroll_behavior: Native document scroll, reversible object poses and SVG contour interpolation; no wheel/touch interception. Complete static document for reduced motion.

components.button_style: Teal primary or outlined secondary, pill corners, 43?50px height
components.input_style: Labelled native controls with 16px corners and visible focus; 16px mobile form text
components.card_style: Rounded paper messages, ticket layout, original product images; 24?44px panel radii explicitly requested by user
components.navigation_pattern: Sticky pill header with mobile expandable menu and preserved anchors
components.modal_style: Native poster dialog with download, Escape close and explicit restored focus
components.list_style: Central date band and alternating event summaries on desktop; left-side date band on mobile
components.component_notes: Required name, unique NPM and self-chosen password; existing operator access; one raffle ticket per NPM.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: Original Sundanese print artwork arranged as a spacious editorial invitation
aesthetic.era_influence: Traditional Sundanese print celebration expressed in an interactive event site
aesthetic.genre: Kasundaan campus festival and authenticated participation portal

visual_language.ornamentation: Original wayang, gunungan and cloud assets grouped in the hero; source artwork remains recognizable
visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous light canvas around cultural artwork and functional sections
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Sage theme panel, warm menfess panel and cream information sections with deep teal actions
visual_language.focal_strategy: Wayang and original 68 emblem on the left, welcoming title on the right; emblem becomes the focal point while scrolling
visual_language.contrast_level: high for text, subtle for background
visual_language.texture_usage: Original PDF floral texture used locally at low opacity

composition.hierarchy_method: Large left-aligned display type and one original emblem, followed by functional sections
composition.grouping_strategy: Date rows, a menfess wall, a perforated raffle ticket, and functional forms
composition.negative_space_role: Keeps the busy original artwork separate from readable interface text

imagery.photo_treatment: Actual merchandise product photos with source alpha masks
imagery.illustration_style: Exclusively original Figma/PDF artwork; no generated illustrations, external stock or invented motifs
graphic_elements: Original Semar and Arjuna PDF images
imagery.pattern_usage: Actual PDF image assets; no CSS-generated cultural pattern

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Inline error and success messages, dismissible toast
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Small button movement and color change
interaction_feel.transition_personality: Continuous, reversible cultural composition; stable readable copy and interactive controls
interaction_feel.loading_style: Visible text status, content never gated

brand_voice_in_ui.formality: Natural Indonesian throughout; Sundanese limited to Wilujeng sumping and Hatur nuhun. Preserve Harewos, Kasundaan and official event names.
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: Concrete verbs for viewing, sending and registering
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Explain the next step without inventing visitor messages
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Plain, actionable, no implementation details for visitors

overview.effect_intensity: Layered wayang stage with persistent object choreography, geometric chapter wipes and protected reading areas
overview.performance_tier: One coalesced scroll listener; no extra animation dependency.
overview.fallback_strategy: Complete ordinary document with theatre and ambient sway disabled for reduced motion
overview.primary_technology: CSS perspective/preserve-3d, translated source cutouts, requestAnimationFrame and SVG contour interpolation

background_effects.description: A teal stage surrounds a morphing cream/sage surface. The original batik kelir feathers radially; theatre outer edges fade softly.
background_effects.technology: SVG path-coordinate interpolation and fill transitions

particle_systems.description: Not used; the page uses native CSS motion and original source artwork.

3d_elements.description: Original flat source cutouts retain CSS 3D choreography. Arjuna/Semar stay fully visible in desktop side wings or a reserved lower mobile shelf. The native header logo stays visible; a separate upright opening logo fades with its chapter. Neither logo rotates.
3d_elements.technology: CSS perspective, preserve-3d, translate3d, rotateY, rotateZ and scale

params.lighting: Static source-art drop shadows and a subtle stage-floor light
params.interaction_model: Reversible native scroll and 1100ms chapter navigation

shader_effects.description: Not used; the page uses native CSS motion and original source artwork.

parallax.speed_curve: Smoothstep interpolation with shallow shared spatial arcs

trigger_points: Every chapter boundary across the single pinned stage
scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: Persistent object paths, independent upright opening logo, always-visible native header logo, gunungan seam, feathered directional clips and compatible SVG surface
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: Native document scroll; no interception of wheel or touch events

scroll_morphing.description: All sections share a pinned viewport; source objects travel between spatial poses, the gunungan crosses a clear seam, and the surface contour/color morph. Form state is retained.

scroll_span.desktop: Nine transitions of about one viewport each
scroll_span.mobile: Same pinned scene sequence with readable internal content

scroll_morphing.scope: Entire page from hero through events, theme, Harewos, raffle, merchandise, dress code, feedback, map and footer

text_effects.description: Canva decorative letters are preserved as their original image; all interface text remains semantic

image_effects.description: Original images preserve their aspect ratios. Arjuna/Semar image children sway by plus/minus 0.85 degrees and 1px over 4.8s/5.6s; this never applies to logos and is disabled for reduced motion.

params.hover_transform: Small product image scale and rotation
params.reveal_animation: Native scroll progress, reversed by scrolling up

canvas_drawings.description: Not used: original Figma assets already carry the cultural identity

svg_animations.description: Plain UI surface only; original cultural artwork stays intact.

visual_effects.composite_notes: Original Figma/PDF assets only. Flat cutouts use reversible CSS 3D paths; a passive scroll listener drives poses, content wipes and SVG interpolation. No extra dependency or perpetual JavaScript render loop. Complete puppet silhouettes remain in desktop side wings or a reserved lower mobile shelf; readable content stays above ornaments. Header and opening logos are independent and never rotate. Chapter clips feather for 64px with opacity at least 0.88 during transitions. Outer theatre rims and the batik kelir feather; panel scroll edges fade only while content overflows on that side. Native dialogs pause/resume chapter motion. Reduced motion restores the full document, removes masks and disables puppet sway.
